The second case, the four-fold transfer in exists_congFin_subset, is weaker because each block is short. The other candidates are the two `calc` branches in valued_mul_apply_le and the two branches in localCong.mul_mem'. These are short calculations, so I did not report them. findings.problem: Both theorems split on `v ∈ T` and re-prove, by `ext y` and `simp only`, the same identification of localWindow with a simpler set. The `v ∉ T` case is character-for-character the same in both. The `v ∈ T` case proves the same fact in two forms: `localWindow = localCong` in one and `localWindow = localIntegralSet ∩ localCong` in the other. Only the final topological step differs (open versus compact). Any change to the definition of `localWindow` must be made in four places. Other places that need window membership or a topological property would have to repeat the same case split.
findings.proposed_change:
Add two characterization lemmas after the definition:
`theorem localWindow_of_notMem (hv : v ∉ T) : localWindow K T n v = localIntegralSet K v` (proof: `ext y; simp only [localWindow, Set.mem_setOf_eq]; exact ⟨fun h => h.1, fun h => ⟨h, fun h' => absurd h' hv⟩⟩`).
`theorem localWindow_of_mem (hv : v ∈ T) : localWindow K T n v = (localCong K v n : Set _)` (proof: `ext y; simp only [localWindow, Set.mem_setOf_eq, SetLike.mem_coe]; exact ⟨fun h => h.2 hv, fun h => ⟨localCong_le_localIntegralSet K v n h, fun _ => h⟩⟩`). This reuses the existing `localCong_le_localIntegralSet`, so the intersection form is not needed. Then:
`isOpen_localWindow`: `by_cases hv : v ∈ T; · rw [localWindow_of_mem K T n v hv]; exact isOpen_localCong K v n; · rw [localWindow_of_notMem K T n v hv]; exact isOpen_localIntegralSet K v`.
`isCompact_localWindow`: `by_cases hv : v ∈ T; · rw [localWindow_of_mem K T n v hv]; exact (isClosed_localCong K v n).isClosed_subset...` is not right as written. Because `localCong ⊆ localIntegralSet`, use `(isCompact_localIntegralSet K v).of_isClosed_subset (isClosed_localCong K v n) (localCong_le_localIntegralSet K v n)`. The other case is `rw [localWindow_of_notMem ..]; exact isCompact_localIntegralSet K v`.
Both uses keep their stated hypotheses, and no new imports are needed. I have not compiled this, and the `of_isClosed_subset` argument order should be checked.
findings.benefit: The window-membership argument is proved once for each case. Each topological lemma then reduces to a rewrite plus an existing fact. The `localWindow` unfolding is localized, so any change to its definition touches two lemmas, not four proof blocks.

findings.problem: The four bullets in `hmem` all do the same thing. Each states a local matrix condition on `finComponent v (glFin g)` or `finComponent v (glFin g⁻¹)` using a long `change`. Each then rewrites with `hgk` and `map_inv` to turn that into the corresponding component of `k` or `k⁻¹`, and closes with `hk'`. The two integrality bullets and the two congruence bullets are the same argument applied to `g` and to `g⁻¹`. The `map_inv, hgk, map_inv` rewrite and the long matrix-coercion `change` are copied twice each.
findings.proposed_change: Prove one small lemma that works for both bullets of each type: for `x : GL (Fin 2) (AdeleRing (𝓞 K) K)` and `k` with `glFin x = k`, `finComponent v (glFin x⁻¹) = (finComponent v k)⁻¹`. Its proof is `rw [map_inv, hgk, map_inv]`. Alternatively, first state `hinv : AdelicLevel.finComponent (𝓞 K) K v (AdelicLevel.glFin (𝓞 K) K g⁻¹) = (AdelicLevel.finComponent (𝓞 K) K v k)⁻¹` and `hfwd : AdelicLevel.finComponent (𝓞 K) K v (AdelicLevel.glFin (𝓞 K) K g) = AdelicLevel.finComponent (𝓞 K) K v k`. Then close the bullets with `simpa [hfwd, hinv]`, or a `show` that no longer mentions `glFin`. Pairing the two bullets with `⟨…, …⟩` from `mem_localCong_iff` also removes the long repeated `Valued.v (… - 1 …)` statements. This is only a modest improvement, because each block is short.
findings.benefit: The conversion between `glFin g⁻¹` and `(finComponent v k)⁻¹` is stated once. The reader sees at a glance that all four goals are the hypotheses on `k` and `k⁻¹`, instead of checking four slightly different `change` blocks.
